summary.text: Thought Expelling Pavilion is Fang clan's wisdom path Immortal Gu House. It complements Fang Di Chang.

claims.text: Fang clan had three new Immortal Gu Houses. This is the third of those three. Fang Di Chang flies out, takes out an Immortal Gu House, and enters it. He activates the house’s method against Zuo Qiu San Sha: Zuo Qiu San Sha’s thoughts fly out of his mind and circle around his body, the Gu worms in his immortal aperture fall into chaos, his killer move fails to activate, and he coughs blood from the backlash. Gong Jiao Che attacks it from afar. The pavilion endures that fire path killer move and activates its method again.

Fang Di Chang activates it targeting Tian Da Ji. Tian Da Ji is startled and releases ancient desolate chickens from his immortal aperture to protect himself, but Fang Di Chang is only bluffing and immediately turns the attack toward Sun Wang. Sun clan Gu Immortals were most conservative. The moment Thought Expelling Pavilion showed such movement, Sun Wang ran away at astonishing speed. Fang Di Chang was familiar with people’s nature. He used Thought Expelling Pavilion a few times and made use of its threat to gain those battle accomplishments.
Deviation (recorded): this page is filed under gu-houses because Thought Expelling Pavilion is a named Immortal Gu House. It is mobile equipment of Fang clan, not a five-region map seat.

Fang Di Chang, inside Thought Expelling Pavilion, is half-kneeling. His expression is distorted as he resists Wan clan’s terrifying killer move with all his strength, blood seeping from his mouth and nose. The alliance immortals first destroy Smoke Wave Building, then destroy Thought Expelling Pavilion. To save Fang Di Chang who was in Thought Expelling Pavilion, Fang Gong and the other immortals are forced to make a move.
